source_summary: Chinese ink-and-light-color lotus pond landscape with lower-half garden scenery; calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from the motif bank.

motifs.name: left_bamboo_marsh_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the low bamboo thicket and marshy shoreline at the left middle, including clustered bamboo stems, fine leaf sprays, low grasses, small shoreline rocks, and pale horizontal water-wash around the bank.
must_preserve: soft gray ink wash under the thicket
short reed and grass strokes along the water edge

motifs.name: central_misty_water_channel
motifs.description: Isolate the quiet receding water channel and distant reed line in the center, with scattered horizontal ink dashes suggesting ripples and a soft atmospheric opening between the left bank and right trees.

motifs.name: lotus_pond_surface
motifs.description: Isolate the broad lotus-covered pond surface across the lower left and center, including floating leaves, buds, blossoms, pale blue-green wash accents, and scattered gray submerged leaf shadows.

motifs.name: lakeside_pavilion_with_figures
motifs.description: Isolate the small waterside pavilion partially sheltered by rocks, including the sloped tiled roof, posts, railing, interior seated scholar figure, and small attendant-like figure near the left post.
must_preserve: tiny human figures with pale robe color accents

motifs.name: bridge_scholar_with_staff
motifs.description: Isolate the scholar standing on the simple plank bridge at lower left, holding a staff, with the bridge rail, vertical supports, and adjacent lotus-edge water directly around him.
must_preserve: small warm face and hair accents
minimal plank bridge and rail construction
nearby lotus pads integrated with the water edge

motifs.name: towering_broadleaf_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the tall broadleaf trees rising on the right, including multiple pale trunks, branching limbs, and repeated rounded leaf clusters from the midsection to the upper right canopy.
must_preserve: pale trunk washes with dark contour lines
light ink foliage texture without filling the interiors

motifs.name: right_rockery_and_bamboo
motifs.description: Isolate the dramatic garden rockery on the right with adjacent dark bamboo sprays, including perforated rock forms, heavy black ink cavities, angular contours, gray washes, and drooping bamboo leaves.
must_preserve: thin bamboo stems and needle leaves
contrast between dense bamboo and pale stone surfaces

motifs.name: foreground_sloping_bank_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the lower sloping earthen bank and foreground rocks, including the curved embankment, grasses, dry-brush texture, dark rock crevices, and pale wash transitions into the pond.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
